commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Enemies can do no harm to a ruler who has worthy people around him and knows how to conduct himself. The worthy are those fit in wisdom and conduct. Conducting himself means not straying from righteousness and sound policy. Enemies work by deceit, by splitting allies, by stirring up new foes and by force, but none of this reaches one who knows and heeds those who know.
